findings.title: Odd ternary in hook_capturing_compressor_factory::compressor::compress lacks explanatory…
findings.claim: The `data.size ? std::move(data) : rpc::snd_buf(temporary_buffer<char>())` ternary is odd and unexplained; should be simplified to `_delegate.compress(head_space, std::move(data))` or given a comment.

findings.title: Unused is_server parameter in four-argument negotiate override
findings.claim: The `is_server` parameter in the four-argument `negotiate` override is unused, which can warn under `-Wunused-parameter` with `-Werror`.

findings.title: Documentation overstates when stream connection is shut down
findings.claim: The "Closing a stream" doc and the `sink` comment in `rpc_types.hh` state the connection is shut down only once both halves are closed, but it is also stopped on error or peer close (rpc.cc:1063 and rpc.cc:1286); wording should say "normally shut down".

findings.title: PR body contains 'Generated with Claude Code' attribution line
findings.claim: The PR body ends with a "Generated with Claude Code" line, which should be removed per instructions forbidding that attribution.
